limits: Two simple-start and two obstacle examples are existing simulation references. The third obstacle is a fresh physical replay of another existing trajectory.
The horizontal gate uses measured phone positions. Diagonal and vertical gate examples are disclosed robot augmentations; the vertical gate is relocated and widened.
Literal shared-frame obstacle-path transfers failed contact or reach checks and remain excluded. This library does not claim those transfers succeeded.
Whole-episode depth failures remain visible. Only separately depth-qualified labels are supplied by the loader.
